Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

Stylized dark-fantasy chibi mage battle short, based on the reference character: a small witch girl with long curly black hair, pale skin, large expressive eyes, a tall black witch hat decorated with purple roses, and a layered black-purple dress. Keep the character design highly consistent with the reference image. Cute proportions, but the battle performance is powerful, dramatic, and confident. Atmosphere mysterious and intense, with purple-black magic effects, smoky shadows, glowing sigils, and a moonlit fantasy battlefield.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] Medium shot opens on the witch standing in a ruined stone courtyard at night, purple mist drifting across the ground, loose hair and dress edges moving slightly in the wind. She slowly raises her wand or staff, eyes narrowing with confidence. She speaks in Chinese: “想试试我的魔法吗？” A faint purple glow begins to gather in her hand.

[2s-4s] Hard cut to a lower-angle shot. A dark shadow creature or magical enemy lunges into frame from the side. The witch pivots quickly, steps back, and swings her wand in a smooth arc. A crescent-shaped purple spell flashes outward. Her sleeves and dress follow the motion naturally. The first spell impact lands with a bright burst and drifting black particles.

[4s-6.5s] Cut to a side action shot. The witch points forward sharply and casts a second spell with more force, forming layered glowing runes in front of her. She speaks in Chinese with a stronger tone: “黑夜，听从我的召唤！” Multiple purple energy bolts fire in sequence toward the enemy. Each bolt should be clearly synced to her wand movement and hand gesture.

[6.5s-9s] Cut to a closer shot as the enemy attacks back. The witch turns her body, lifts one arm, and creates a circular purple-black shield in front of herself. Sparks, smoke, and magical fragments explode outward on impact. Her face stays focused and slightly fierce. After blocking, she slides one foot back and prepares a stronger finishing spell.

[9s-12s] Dynamic hero shot. The witch spins once, cloak and hair swirling, then plants her feet and lifts the wand overhead. A large magic circle appears beneath her and another behind her back. Energy gathers rapidly, bright purple at the core and darker black-violet smoke around the edges. She speaks in Chinese: “暗影之门，开启吧！” The final spell forms as a concentrated beam or roaring magical blast.

[12s-15s] Final attack lands. The enemy is overwhelmed by the purple-black magic explosion and dissolves into shadow fragments. The witch lands lightly, the magic glow fading around her. She lowers her wand with a confident, slightly smug expression and says in Chinese: “结束了。” Final pose holds for a beat, with drifting purple embers in the air.

Camera:
Cinematic but controlled. Use readable action framing, medium shots, low-angle hero shots, and a few close action beats. Motion should feel energetic but not chaotic. No excessive shaky cam, no overly fast spinning camera, no messy composition. Keep the witch clearly visible at all times and preserve her full costume silhouette.

Action and performance:
The witch must move like a spellcaster: wand-led gestures, arm sweeps, finger control, quick pivots, magical blocking, and a strong finishing cast. Hair, hat, sleeves, and layered skirt should react naturally to her movements. Magic timing must match body timing. Her facial expression should evolve from playful confidence to battle focus, then back to calm confidence at the end.

Audio:
Dark fantasy orchestral battle score with low strings, deep drum hits, and rising choir texture. Add magical sound effects precisely synced to each spell cast: energy charging hum, rune activation sparkle, wand swish, shield impact burst, explosion bloom, and shadow-disintegration particles. Background ambience includes night wind and faint battlefield reverb. The Chinese voice should sound like a young witch girl, clear Mandarin, confident and slightly playful, with clean lip-sync matching the spoken lines.

Dialogue:
[0s-2s] “想试试我的魔法吗？”
[4s-6.5s] “黑夜，听从我的召唤！”
[9s-12s] “暗影之门，开启吧！”
[12s-15s] “结束了。”

widgets_values:
A warm two-character dialogue scene using three reference images as the core visual material. Reference image 1 is a 3D-animated young man with black hair tied in a topknot, wearing a flowing white hanfu robe with wide sleeves. Reference image 2 is a cute 3D chibi-style little girl with long dark hair and floral hair accessories, wearing a cream hanfu dress with an orange-red waist sash and floral embroidery. Reference image 3 is a serene Chinese courtyard garden with grey-tiled roofs, a blooming pink peach blossom tree, stone pathways and lush greenery under a soft blue sky. The two characters stand in the courtyard and have a gentle, heartwarming conversation. Both characters keep their exact appearance from the reference images — same faces, same hairstyles, same costumes. Render in a consistent high-quality 3D animation style, like a polished animated short film.

Timeline:  
[0s-3s] Establishing shot. The camera slowly pushes into the courtyard. Pink petals drift down from the blossom tree. The young man in white stands under the tree, looking up at the flowers with a soft smile.

[3s-6.5s] The little girl runs in along the stone path, skirt swaying, and stops beside him, looking up with sparkling excited eyes. She says in Chinese, in a bright childlike voice: "哇——真的好漂亮！阿兄，你一大早就在这里等花开吗？"

[6.5s-10s] The young man turns to her, raises his hand and gently catches a falling petal. He replies in Chinese, in a warm soft voice: "嗯，等你一起看。" The girl tilts her head and giggles.

[10s-13s] Close two-shot. The girl says cheerfully in Chinese: "那说好了，明年花开，我们还来这里！" The young man nods with a smile and answers: "好，一言为定。"

[13s-15s] The camera slowly pulls back. The two stand side by side under the blossom tree as petals fall around them. The scene settles into a calm, warm final frame.

Performance and lip sync:  
Both characters speak natural Mandarin Chinese with clear lip sync matching the dialogue lines. Facial expressions follow the emotion of each line — curiosity, surprise, warmth, joy. Add subtle idle motion between lines: breathing, blinking, hair and fabric swaying in a light breeze.

Camera:  
Slow, smooth cinematic movement. Gentle push-in at the start, medium two-shots during dialogue, a soft close-up when the girl speaks her final line, and a slow pull-back at the end. No handheld shake, no fast cuts, no spinning.

Audio:  
Quiet courtyard ambience — soft wind, distant birds, rustling leaves. Clear Chinese voice lines for both characters, a gentle warm piano-and-strings background score at low volume. No subtitles on screen.

Constraints:  
Preserve both characters' identity, costume and art style exactly as in the reference images. Keep the courtyard layout and the pink blossom tree consistent with reference image 3. Consistent 3D animation rendering across the whole clip. No extra characters, no text overlays, no subtitles, no scene changes.
